label: every headword character has a direct script-lesson owner
note: RE-DERIVED FROM DIRECT OWNERS, NOT ESTIMATED. 69 distinct Malayalam characters appear in headwords across 643 lessons, and all 69 occur in the headword of a writing/script lesson -- 100 per cent direct-owner closure. The last nine to close were given one letter lesson each by HL-C443 (chapters 113-114), each taught from the word the reader had been reading it in: ള ḷa U+0D33, ശ śa U+0D36, ങ ṅa U+0D19, ർ chillu-r U+0D7C, ധ dha U+0D27, ൈ ai sign U+0D48, ബ ba U+0D2C, ഖ kha U+0D16 and ഛ chha U+0D1B. This is deliberately a DIRECT-OWNER measure: the broader script-closure gate can credit glyphs appearing inside a writing lesson's examples. The two letters called 'sha' are told apart by codepoint: U+0D36 ശ is directly owned by ML-W113-sha, and U+0D37 ഷ by ML-S121-letter-ssa.
